verdict.rationale: A probe reports that an official Runloop MCP server is documented on the AI-tools docs page, and that page is described as adding Runloop API context to LLMs. That points to a first-party MCP server agents can connect to, but the pack gives no detail on what it exposes, how to install it, or how authentication works. The MCP Hub feature (proxying third-party MCP tool servers into Devboxes) is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented MCP server tools/capabilities, setup and connection instructions, auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add context about the Runloop API to your LLMs
